verdict.rationale: Cactus documents Whistle, a 16.9 MB on-device CPU speech-to-text model in seven languages. needle.stream(chunks) transcribes live for as long as the microphone runs, and the README also covers word timestamps and keyword biasing. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Whistle's live streaming quality, and documented latency or real-time performance figures.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model

citations.quote: Whistle is our speech-to-text model, one 16.9 MB file on the CPU
needle.stream(chunks) transcribes live for as long as the microphone runs, committing the words two passes agree on.
No GPU, no server, and no data leaving the device.
